identity.name: Ransomware Pre-Deployment Simulation
identity.summary: Simulates the pre-deployment sequence used by ransomware operators before encryption impact, with the story centered on Sophos stopping the chain before business damage occurs.

narrative.title: {{customerName}} — Live Attack Chain
narrative.subtitle: A realistic multi-stage ransomware storyline built to show stakeholders exactly how a high-consequence attack unfolds, why it matters to {{customerName}}, and how Sophos surfaces the incident inside Central before impact becomes business reality.
businessStakes: Loss of recovery options before encryption begins
Executive escalation and business continuity impact
narrative.transitionLine: Now let’s move into Sophos Central and show how this incident becomes visible to your team in real time.
talkingPoints: Ransomware operators spend time removing recovery options before they encrypt anything — they are maximizing blast radius.
Shadow copy deletion is one of the highest-confidence ransomware precursor signals in MDR telemetry.
Sophos changes the outcome by surfacing and stopping the chain before business impact becomes reality.

healthcare: For {{customerName}}, ransomware is not just an IT incident — it can become a patient safety and continuity event.
When clinical users lose access to systems, the cost is measured in delayed care, not just downtime.
financial_services: For {{customerName}}, a compromise like this puts customer trust, transactional systems, and regulatory exposure on the line.
The ability to surface and investigate this immediately materially changes financial and reputational impact.
manufacturing: For {{customerName}}, disruption here can move from IT systems into production schedules, shipping, and revenue impact.
Stopping the chain before impact is what protects operational continuity.

runbookSteps: Open with business stakes, not telemetry.
Tell the attack story in three beats: preparation, movement toward impact, Sophos intervention.
Use the expected detections as the promise of what stakeholders are about to see in Central.
Then pivot directly into the injected Sophos Central experience to prove the storyline live.
clickPath: Start on the alert view and show the critical ransomware-related precursor activity that would immediately draw analyst attention.
Open the investigation or case context to show how Sophos connects the activity into a coherent incident, not just isolated alerts.
Move into detections and threat activity to prove the attack chain, then close on the response outcome and why the attack did not become a business crisis.

slides.title: Initial compromise at {{customerName}}
slides.body: A user opens a convincing business file and triggers a ransomware chain on DESKTOP-FIN042. What looks like a single bad click quickly becomes an enterprise risk event for {{customerName}}.

slides.title: The attacker moves toward impact
slides.body: Before encryption begins, the attacker weakens recovery by disabling protections, targeting shadow copies, and staging the conditions for business disruption.

slides.title: Sophos changes the outcome
slides.body: Sophos surfaces the precursor behavior, escalates the threat, and gives the team at {{customerName}} a response path before encryption becomes business reality.

mitreTechniques.name: Impair Defenses: Disable or Modify Tools

phases.label: Disable backup and recovery services
phases.description: The attacker disables or impairs the Windows services that make recovery possible after ransomware deployment.

phases.label: Target recovery mechanisms
phases.description: The attacker enumerates and targets volume shadow copies, creating the classic no-return ransomware precursor moment.

phases.label: Stage ransom note and encrypted file markers
phases.description: The attacker stages ransom artifacts and visible evidence of impact, even before real encryption is allowed to occur in the demo path.

phases.label: Generate incident handoff
phases.description: The scenario culminates in an investigation-ready handoff for the security console and analyst story.

expectedOutcome.sophosOutcome: Sophos escalates and interrupts the ransomware chain before broad encryption impact occurs.

expectedDetections.detection: VSS and WBEngine service disabled by non-system process
vssadmin or wmic shadowcopy delete command execution
Mass file extension change to .encrypted or equivalent impact markers
High-confidence ransomware precursor — automatic MDR escalation
